label: positive

blockers.detail: every input gets a fresh lzma_stream (LZMA_STREAM_INIT) that is initialised exactly once, so the reuse paths of lzma_alone_decoder_init()/lzma_lz_decoder_init() (existing coder, existing dictionary) are never taken

rationale_zh: 本次提交修改 lzma_lz_decoder_init() 的“复用已有字典”逻辑，使其在内存分配失败后被再次初始化时也安全；这段逻辑只有在同一个 lzma_stream 被重复初始化（coder 与字典已存在）时才会走到。fuzz_decode_alone 每个输入都新建一个 lzma_stream、只初始化一次，复用分支（coder != NULL、字典大小相同）从未执行，复用状态下的缺陷也就无从暴露。harness 照常运行不报错，只是静默缺失状态复用路径的覆盖；这一缺口自 harness 创建以来一直存在，属于非本次引入的隐式 state 退化。维护者随后在 d4217668a7 让 fuzzer 对同一 stream 连续初始化三次。
rationale_en: This commit changes the reuse-the-existing-dictionary logic of lzma_lz_decoder_init() so that re-initialisation after an allocation failure is safe; that logic only runs when the same lzma_stream is initialised again (coder and dictionary already exist). fuzz_decode_alone creates a fresh lzma_stream for every input and initialises it once, so the reuse branches (coder != NULL, same dictionary size) never execute and defects in the reused state cannot surface. The harness runs normally while silently missing coverage of the state-reuse paths; the gap has existed since the harness was written. Pre-existing silent state degradation; the maintainers then made the fuzzers re-initialise the same stream three times in d4217668a7.
